unit: nlm-baselines (untuned base model, local-only adapters, central adapter)
what: Task B baselines. The frozen OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (Qwen3) base is scored untuned; each site trains the same LoRA adapter alone on its own text (6 epochs); a central adapter is trained on both sites' text pooled (baseline only, outside the federated path). Each site's rare failure family is never in its training text.

target.metric: FAMILY accuracy on the test set for the family each site never logged at home (Site A: MOBILITY, Site B: CONGESTION), 100 test examples each
target.direction: local-only adapters expected at or below 0.35 (near zero, never shown the family); untuned base expected at or below 0.45 (three-way choice, near chance); central expected at or above 0.90

split.corpus: train 700, validation 90, test 260 examples per site (config in the corpus manifest)

model_id: OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (organisers' bucket) + LoRA r=8 alpha=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; ran-fl/taskb/model-code/model.py
grader: ran-fl/taskb/taskb_job.py (deterministic: log-likelihood ranking of the candidate FAMILY, CAUSE and ACTION; no model-written labels, no LLM judge)
